item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel C1: The 2026-10-06 entry for this record said the 2033 date comes from the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance. That was wrong. The Port's 2017 staff report (Item 9B, p.7) puts the Schedule of Performance in the Disposition and Development Agreement (DDA) between the Port and the developer, which is a different agreement from the Development Agreement between the City and the developer. The report says the developer must complete phase 2 within 16 years of project approval, but it never states the year 2033; 2033 is Pier & Point's own arithmetic (2017 plus 16 years). It stays labelled a legal outside date, not an expected completion.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel C1: The 2033 date shown for Parcel C1 is Pier & Point's arithmetic for the second-phase outside date in the Disposition and Development Agreement (DDA)'s Schedule of Performance, which is separate from the City's Development Agreement. No source read says which phase C1 is in under the DDA; the Port places the affordable parcel C1B in Phase 3. It remains labelled a legal outside date, not a forecast.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel C1: The 2033 date on this record was drawn as an expected completion. The Port's 2017 staff report calls it an outside date in the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance (Phase 2 within 16 years of approval), not a construction schedule. It is now labelled a legal deadline and no longer moves this record's status on the map or the timeline.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel C1: Parcel C1's map use is now 'mixed', since the D4D shows it as a garage or partial garage that may be residential or commercial. The 2033 completion milestone is now labelled a soft 2017 outside date that down market delay has tolled and Port Item 11A proposes to reset. The Item 11A milestones are dated to the Aug 7, 2026 staff report, and C1B is described as listed in Phase 3 rather than moved there. The map notes now cite the Port for the affordable parcels and current status, and no longer claim the site was never subdivided by the Assessor. The Figure 1.1.2 image credit no longer says 'adopted 2017', and the Mayor's signing entry now states the Board of Supervisors' first-reading vote on Oct 31, 2017 and final passage on Nov 14, 2017.

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel C1: The DDA's Schedule of Performance sets completion of Phase 2 at 16 years after Project approval; Pier & Point's arithmetic from 2017 gives about 2033 (the Port's report states no calendar year). No source read says C1A, C1B or C1C is a Phase 2 parcel: Port Item 11A places the affordable parcel C1B in Phase 3, and the Port's proposed 2026 phasing plan groups the C1 parcels with Parcel K South in subphase 2B. Not a forecast for this parcel (~2033)
